title: Sauerbraten Pilaf Bake
description: A German-inspired comfort dish featuring tender beef and flavorful pilaf.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high.
Sear beef until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.
Add polish to pot and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Add pilaf, stirring to combine with polish, about 2-3 minutes.
Return beef to pot and add salt, pepper, and cheese.
Transfer pot to preheated oven and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes, or until beef reaches 160°F (71°C).
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
